units.name: Department of Management Sciences
units.evidence: The department page verifies name and college. The official faculty list places Don Pope in Management Sciences; his Teaching tab explicitly lists Operations Management, Global Supply Chain Management, and Logistics & Supply Chain Management across multiple recent terms including 2026.

decisions.reason: Pure Information Systems is described as a degree in computing, programming and databases; not retained as an operations unit.
Official department name is plural Management Sciences; ongoing operations and supply-chain teaching is explicitly documented by its faculty.
